name: Breeze Canna x Skunk House Pro Rosin Disposable Vape | Cherry Burger
description: Born from an obsession with exceptional cannabis, SkunkHouse Genetics has been crafting elite genetics since 2008—combining standout terpene profiles, serious potency, and grower-focused structure that helped shape modern hash-making through their work with GMO. This perfectly balanced hybrid blends sweet cherry pie and diesel fuel, with myrcene-rich flavor and calming, stress-relieving effects that soothe the body without slowing you down.
